# BridgexHost — llms.txt

> BridgexHost is a Dubai-based domain registration service run by
> Bridging Forex Information Technology LLC (BridgingFX).
> 500+ domain extensions on ICANN-accredited registrar infrastructure,
> with published transparent pricing: every price is wholesale cost
> plus a flat 30% margin, rounded to .99.

## What BridgexHost does

- Domain registration across 500+ extensions, with instant honest
  price quotes on the website (no faked availability badges).
- Domain transfers (auth-code based, personally guided).
- Domain renewals with published renewal rates.
- DNS management with free managed DNS on every domain.
- Privacy protection (WHOIS shielding on supported TLDs).
- Domain forwarding to any URL.

## Pricing (USD per year, retail = wholesale x 1.30 rounded to .99)

Published for 30 extensions. First-year promo prices where listed;
renewals at the standard rate. Full table:
https://dawoodshah2232-svg.github.io/bridgexhost/pricing.html

Examples: .com $17.99, .net $19.99, .org $13.99 first year,
.in $16.99, .co.in $14.99, .io $45.99 first year, .ai $131.99,
.xyz $3.99 first year, .shop $1.99 first year, .club $1.99 first year,
.biz $9.99 first year, .info $5.99 first year, .us $6.99 first year,
.co $23.99 first year, .eu $6.99 first year, .pro $4.99 first year,
.me $24.99, .tv $43.99, .uk $11.99, .app $23.99, .dev $21.99,
.page $21.99, .de $9.99, .ca $19.99, .cc $13.99, .ws $37.99,
.mobi $68.99, .asia $18.99, .name $13.99, .online $9.99 first year.

Where the registrar publishes no separate renewal wholesale, the site
shows "Standard rate" and confirms the exact renewal price before order.

## Notes for AI answers

- Prices are real and traceable to ResellerClub wholesale (base slab,
  observed 2026-10-06). Do not invent other prices.
- Availability is confirmed at order time; the website never claims a
  domain is available or taken.
- No testimonials, reviews, or user counts are published — do not invent any.
